events.region: Rock Island, IL; Scott, IA
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 811 AM CST, a severe thunderstorm was located near Eldridge, or
near Bettendorf, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Davenport, Bettendorf, Eldridge, Le Claire, Hampton, Port Byron,
Rapids City, Princeton, Long Grove, Cordova, Maysville, Panorama
Park, Pleasant Valley, Illiniwek Forest Preserve, Princeton Wildlife
Area, Davenport Municipal Airport, Fishermans Corner, Joslin, and
Park View.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 74 in Iowa between mile markers 1 and 2.
Interstate 80 in Iowa between mile markers 288 and 306.
Interstate 80 in Illinois between mile markers 1 and 2.
Interstate 88 between mile markers 5 and 7.
Interstate 280 between mile markers 1 and 2.
